turnaround_reason: SolarEdge collapsed from >$300 to the low-$20s on a channel-inventory glut, European demand air-pocket, and deep operating losses. It is now recovering: revenue is growing ~41% off the trough, gross margin is climbing back, FCF has turned positive, and U.S. domestic-content manufacturing plus storage give it a concrete self-help path. Q2 earnings pre-market 2026-08-05 is a hard binary catalyst.
bullish_points: Clear recovery inflection: revenue +41.5% TTM, FCF ~+$278M turned positive, current ratio 2.0, and last two prints beat (Feb +40%, Nov +27%)
Hard binary catalyst tomorrow (2026-08-05 pre-market): Q2 guide was $325-355M with a target of near-breakeven operating profit; consensus ~$341M / near-breakeven EPS (a huge YoY swing)
U.S. domestic-content manufacturing scaling into IRA/45X demand supports volumes and margin — a structural, policy-backed tailwind
High short interest (~20% of float, short ratio 4.3) sets up a squeeze on any beat-and-raise
Momentum into the print (+15.5% 5d) with price above the 200-day MA (recovering screen mode confirmed)
Deep, liquid options chain (14 expiries out to Dec 2028) for defined-risk expression around the event
bearish_points: Still fundamentally unprofitable: operating margin -15%, profit margin -29%, EV/EBITDA negative; the 'improving' is off a very low base
Stock has already run ~15% in 5 days into a coin-flip print — a beat may be partly priced, an in-line/miss could round-trip fast
-19.5% over 30 days shows the tape is still whippy and headline-sensitive
P/B ~6.9 and forward P/E ~30 mean you are paying up for a recovery that must actually materialize
European resi solar demand and rate sensitivity remain the swing factor and are outside management control
Guidance, not the print, will drive the move; a soft H2 outlook could overwhelm a clean Q2 beat
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings + H2 guidance — confirmation of the return to operating breakeven and a constructive back-half outlook
suggested_trade: Event trade: keep it small and defined-risk given the print is <24h out and the stock already ran. Prefer a modest spot starter OR a defined-risk long call spread (e.g. Nov 2026) sized so a gap-down is survivable; avoid naked long premium into elevated event risk
key_risk: A Q2 beat paired with soft/uncertain H2 guidance triggers a 'sell the news' gap-down given the 15% pre-print run and 30x forward multiple
would_skip_if: You are not willing to hold through a binary overnight gap; if flat into the print, wait and react to the guide rather than pre-position
